definitions.gloss: full repayment; paying off a debt completely
definitions.explanation: The act of finishing payment on a loan, debt, or other financial obligation. Means paying the entire amount owed, with nothing remaining.

examples.japanese: ⟦ローン→ローン：06579_roon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{完済|かんさい}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{住宅|じゅうたく}→住宅：03280_juutaku⟧⟦ローン→ローン：06579_roon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{完済|かんさい}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧あと{五年|ごねん}⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: It will take five more years to pay off the mortgage.

examples.japanese: ⟦{借金|しゃっきん}→借金：03203_shakkin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{完済|かんさい}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦やっと→やっと：01561_yatto⟧⟦{肩|かた}→肩：02192_kata⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{荷|に}→荷：28294_ni⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{下|お}りた。
examples.english: After paying off all my debts, I finally felt a weight lifted from my shoulders.

notes:
{完済|かんさい} means paying off a debt or loan completely, with nothing remaining.

FORMS:
{完|かん} (complete) + {済|さい} (settle, finish)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦ローン→ローン：06579_roon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{完済|かんさい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to pay off a loan
- ⟦{借金|しゃっきん}→借金：03203_shakkin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{完済|かんさい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to pay off a debt
- {完済|かんさい}⟦{証明書|しょうめいしょ}→証明書：09785_shoumeisho⟧: certificate of full repayment
- {完済|かんさい}{日|び}: date of final payment

RELATED FINANCIAL TERMS:
- ⟦{返済|へんさい}→返済：04776_hensai⟧: repayment (not necessarily complete)
- {未済|みさい}: unpaid, outstanding
- ⟦{繰|く}り{上|あ}げ→繰り上げ：07803_kuriage⟧⟦{返済|へんさい}→返済：04776_hensai⟧: early repayment

WATCH OUT:
⟦{関西|かんさい}→関西：00179_kansai⟧ (Kansai region) — completely different kanji and meaning.

REGISTER:
Formal/financial. Commonly appears in banking and legal contexts.
